title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 28: Ahaz's idolatry, Judah's defeats, Oded's plea for the captives, and Ahaz's further unfaithfulness.

questions.text: What did Ahaz make for the Baals?
questions.explanation: Ahaz walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

questions.text: Where did Ahaz burn incense and burn his children in the fire?
questions.explanation: He burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire.

answers.text: In the valley of the son of Hinnom

questions.text: Who killed one hundred twenty thousand in Judah in one day?
questions.explanation: Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men.

questions.text: Whom did Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, kill along with Azrikam and Elkanah?
questions.explanation: Zichri killed Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

questions.text: What was the name of the prophet of Yahweh who met the army that came to Samaria?
questions.explanation: A prophet of Yahweh was there, whose name was Oded, and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria.

questions.text: To which city were the captives brought back to their brothers?
questions.explanation: The men took the captives, clothed and fed them, carried the feeble on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees.

answers.text: Damascus, the city of the Syrians
Jericho, the city of palm trees

questions.text: Which king of Assyria came to Ahaz but did not strengthen him?
questions.explanation: Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn't strengthen him.

questions.text: To which gods did Ahaz sacrifice, hoping they would help him?
questions.explanation: He sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, saying that because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, they might help him.

questions.text: What did Ahaz do to the doors of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Ahaz cut the vessels of God's house in pieces and shut up the doors of Yahweh's house.
Ahaz slept with his fathers, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
